summary.text: CARGONET AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2001-06-28. Its website describes the business as follows: "CargoNet er Norges ledende godstransportør på jernbane. Vi kjører over hele Norge, og mellom Norge og Sverige. I tillegg drifter vi flere av godsterminalene i Norge." Its main industry code is 49.200 (godstransport med jernbane). The register shows 493 employees and 24 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 369 654 000 NOK and the annual result was -69 496 000 NOK; operating income was up from 1 306 205 000 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Robin Olsen (daglig leder) and Gro Bakstad (styrets leder), with 7 other board members. Its verified website is cargonet.no, which links to its LinkedIn profile. Its website links to a careers page or job board. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 493 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-07-09.
